description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) for managing sync state information using Room persistence library. It provides methods to retrieve the last sync timestamp and to insert or update sync state entities in the local database.

classes.name: SyncStateDao
classes.description: Interface annotated with @Dao that declares database operations for sync state management.

methods.name: getLastSyncAt
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the last synchronization for the specified key from the sync_state table.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Inserts a new SyncStateEntity or replaces an existing one in the database, handling conflicts by replacing.
